instructions.instruction: Select tickets, define a goal, and commit to a sprint scope.
instructions.original_snippets: Select tickets, define a goal, and commit to a sprint scope.

instructions.instruction: **Rule:** Don't overcommit — plan for ≤80% of theoretical capacity.
instructions.original_snippets: **Rule:** Don't overcommit — plan for ≤80% of theoretical capacity.
instructions.relevant_when: When a user asks for planning work that should trigger plan-sprint.

instructions.instruction: **Define sprint goal** — one sentence describing the sprint's outcome. Every selected ticket should support this goal.
instructions.original_snippets: **Define sprint goal** — one sentence describing the sprint's outcome. Every selected ticket should support this goal.

instructions.instruction: **Select tickets** — start from the top of the backlog, stop when total estimate reaches ≤80% of capacity (see [Capacity Heuristics](#capacity-heuristics) below).

instructions.instruction: **Validate** — check no ticket has unresolved dependencies, unclear acceptance criteria, or missing estimates. Use the [Common Anti-Patterns](#common-anti-patterns) table as a checklist.
